scope: Read-only structural inventory of aligned basic model candidates in the original main executable, with in-image vector/material/segment/index/UV bounds, finite vector data and index-range checks. Two particle roots are confirmed by existing code literals; remaining candidates require caller/reference evidence.
limitations: This is not exhaustive discovery: runtime-allocated/relocated structures, alternate model formats, overlays and external assets are outside this scan. Count/length bounds and nonzero valid groups restrict accepted candidates. Rejections are recorded explicitly.

Static material profiles use original unmodified flags and default dispatch mask; runtime overrides and geometric near-plane crossings are not proved. Structural validity alone does not establish asset identity or actual game reachability.
